summary: The school district urges the FCC to preserve and strengthen the E-Rate program, rejecting any proposal to sunset or eliminate it, and emphasizing the program's essential role in providing reliable broadband connectivity for modern education.

claims.argument: Reject proposals to sunset, eliminate, or phase out the E-Rate program
claims.evidence_quote: Now is not the time to undermine the foundation of modern education. I urge the Commission to protect E-Rate so public schools can continue providing all students with the reliable connectivity they need to succeed.
